entities.name: Mr. Towning
entities.description: A kind older human who runs the general store in Saddlebrush on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane Towning relocated to after the Omenpaths opened.

entities.name: Saddlebrush
entities.description: The town where Towning runs the general store.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A customer who brings money to Towning's store and has a ranch.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Pathways whose opening led Towning to relocate.

events.summary: Annie Flash put a lockbox of cash on the counter; Towning split it in two and safed his share.
events.quote: He divided the money into two equal parts, securing his share in a safe behind the counter and leaving Annie with her portion.

events.summary: Towning tossed Annie an apple and promised sweet grain for Fortune in the morning.
events.quote: Mr. Towning then tossed Annie a shiny red apple

relations.quote: he trusts her judgment and values their longstanding partnership
